name: OdaStream ~Akumu ni Torawareta Marionnette~
original_name: OdaStream～悪夢に因われたマリオネット～
source:
--The artificial life "Magatama"--

As Magatama was created with purpose, their existence is only
guaranteed by perusing the purpose and contributing to the human race.

Maybe it is our responsibility to set the place they can do what they should do...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ204145.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
——人工生命“勾玉”——

勾玉被创造出来是为了完成某种目的，因此只有追求这一目的、为人类作出贡献，它们的存在才有保障。

也许，我们有责任为它们设定一个能够完成使命的场所……

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ204145.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
